rationale: The papers 'On the Origin of Solar Halo Coronal Mass Ejections' and 'The State of the Heliosphere Revealed by Limb Halo Coronal Mass Ejections in Solar Cycles 23 and 24' provide insights into the properties and behaviors of halo CMEs, while 'Higher-speed coronal mass ejections and their geoeffectiveness' discusses the characteristics of higher-speed CMEs, contributing evidence relevant to the mechanisms behind their speeds.
